# BPMN Desk 0.4.0

- Read-only Flowable REST 7.2 monitoring: definitions, instances, executions, tasks and variables.
- Dead-letter jobs with stack traces and diagram markers; navigation between parent and child instances.
- Bounded version summaries, filters, pagination, independent monitors and SVG/PNG exports with state markers.
- A shared start page, BPMN/Flowable/Camunda 7 creation menu and global connection settings.
- Preserved drafts and canonical file paths when reopening documents; a single language picker control.

AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` were built in [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/michaelbrylevskii/bpmn-desk/actions/runs/38060956883). Each platform passed 65 E2E and 13 runtime scenarios; unit tests: 84 on Linux, 82 passed and two symlink skips on Windows.

Monitoring excludes administration, history and Camunda 7 runtime. Windows executables are unsigned; manual installer acceptance is not confirmed. macOS is not available.
